The 9V alloy containing gamma single-phase polycrystals showed about 500MPa yield strength at 293K, and it is deformable up to about 0.25 strain.
The 9V alloy containing gamma single-phase polycrystals showed about 500MPa yield strength at 293K, and it is deformable up to about 0.25 strain.
The 45V alloy containing coarse grained beta phase showed almost negligible deformability at room temperature, but its yield stress was as high as 1000MPa.

The 36V alloy containing about 73% beta phase showed a high yield strength that is near that in 45V alloy, and at the same time it showed about 15% deformability under the compression test at room temperature.
It can be considered that a mixture rule can be applied to the constitution dependence of the strength both at lower temperature region and at higher temperature region.
the beta phase is softer than the gamma phase at room temperature, but the temperature above which the strength becomes lower is higher in the gamma phase than in the beta phase.
